subject.title: [Feature]: Built-in auto-update with configurable schedule, confirmation, and post-update notification

question: What permanent core updater workflow should OpenClaw support for scheduled approval, silent updates, and post-restart channel notifications?
rationale: The remaining work adds config surface and changes consent, unattended package execution, restart persistence, and cross-channel delivery policy, which is product/security direction rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Design the core workflow
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a default-off updater engine that reuses `update.run`/external updater semantics with explicit consent and delivery rules.

options.title: Split the remaining surfaces
options.body: Move scheduling, approval, notification, and on-demand `/update` into separate canonical issues, then close this only after the linked scope is preserved.

options.title: Defer built-in automation
options.body: Leave cron/BOOT.md/operator kits as the supported path for now and close the core feature as not planned.

recommendation.title: Design the core workflow
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a default-off updater engine that reuses `update.run`/external updater semantics with explicit consent and delivery rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the latest detailed issue review and explicitly framed this as the canonical updater engine/workflow tracker rather than a UI-only follow-up.
